description_en: Modifies the automatic release time of a specified pay-as-you-go or spot instance. You can also use this operation to cancel the automatic release feature
description_zh: 本接口用于修改指定按量付费实例或者抢占式实例的自动释放时间，同时支持取消自动释放功能
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-instance-auto-release-time --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp1env7nl3mijm2t0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceAutoReleaseTime

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance for which to configure automatic release
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The automatic release time. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If the value of seconds (`ss`) is not `00`, the time is automatically set to the start of the current minute (`mm`).

The earliest release time must be at least 30 minutes from the current time.

The latest release time cannot be more than three years from the current time.

If you do not specify the AutoReleaseTime parameter, the automatic release feature is canceled and the ECS instance is no longer automatically released
parameters.help_zh:
自动释放时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

如果秒（`ss`）取值不是`00`，则自动取为当前分钟（`mm`）开始时。

最短释放时间为当前时间半小时之后。

最长释放时间不能超过当前时间三年。

如果不传入参数`AutoReleaseTime`，表示自动释放功能已取消，ECS实例不再自动释放
parameters.name: auto_release_time
